groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's distance, the Planck 2018 comoving distance of its NED redshift 0.391 (1,567,937,065.74 pc, the SMACS 0723 package's own; the query writes it into each row), spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth. The members' own redshifts are not used for depth: inside a cluster they measure motion, not distance.

sample: The 93 galaxies of the 193-row table that Amrutha et al. (2025), A&A 699, A105 mark as members of SMACS 0723: ClMem = 1 (cluster member; the paper's members lie within its caustic curves); the 100 rows with ClMem = 0 are left out. All 93 kept.
meaning: Member galaxies of SMACS 0723 flagged by Amrutha et al. (2025), A&A 699, A105, one dot each at the cluster's distance. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

toneBy.band: r band (AB), the table's rmag, as observed
toneBy.basis: A display scale, not a rest-frame luminosity: each member's magnitude minus the distance modulus of the comoving distance it is placed at (40.98 mag) darkens its color, from full at -23 to 30% at -18, linear in magnitude, the scale Abell 2744's members use; the members run from 18.34 to 21.97 mag. No k-correction is applied and the band differs from cluster to cluster; the table gives no type or color, so every dot is white.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 4,700 Mpc of the Sun, three times the cluster's distance, so every member shows while the cluster is selected and framed (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).
